applicant_utility.summary: This is a nomination-only award: you cannot apply yourself. Get admitted to an MSc in Chemistry, Biochemistry or Pharmaceutical Sciences at a Swiss university or ETH/EPFL, then persuade your admitting institution to nominate you - the SCS Foundation reviews nominations through a joint industry-academic committee. The award is CHF 36,000 (raised from CHF 30,000), and the current call for the 2027-2029 cohort closes on Thursday, 25 March 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-of-class BSc graduates from outside Switzerland entering Swiss chemistry or life-sciences master's programmes who can win their institution's nomination.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for MSc admission first at a participating institution (Basel, Bern, Geneva, Neuchatel, Zurich, EPFL or ETH)
After admission, ask the programme coordinator about the Alfred Werner nomination - only the institution can put you forward
Prepare strong BSc transcripts that evidence 'highly talented' standing
Diary the nomination deadline: Thursday, 25 March 2027
common_rejection_risks: Assuming a direct application is possible - the Foundation explicitly refuses individual applications
Holding a Swiss BSc; only BSc degrees obtained outside Switzerland qualify
Applying in a field or institution outside the listed Chemistry, Biochemistry or Pharmaceutical Sciences programmes
Your institution declining or missing the nomination because it had its own internal cutoff
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Swiss living costs, tuition where the host university charges it, health insurance and travel - the award is a lump scholarship with no earmarked coverage.
document_audit: No nomination dossier list is published - ask the nominating department what it needs from you well before March
Proof that the BSc was obtained outside Switzerland is the decisive eligibility document
alerts: The amount changed from CHF 30,000 to CHF 36,000, so older profiles of this award are wrong
Nomination timing is set by your university and may fall earlier than the Foundation's 25 March 2027 deadline
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: MSc admission -> institutional nomination to the SCS Foundation -> Alfred Werner Fund Allocation Committee review -> award for the 2027-2029 cohort.
